Your holdings: SMCI (-24.91%), SOXL (-65.72%), and MU (-35.25%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor sector's continued weakness.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your most leveraged and losing positions.
plays: Trim SOXL: The -65.72% loss is brutal. Consider reducing exposure if it breaks below its stop.
Trim SMCI: Down -24.91% and the Intel news is bad for chips. Re-evaluate if it can't hold its stop.
